description: Land Title Settlement Department  -    Minneriya, Hingurakgoda D/S Division,   Polonnaruwa  District - Cad. Map No.120134 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
